item.title: Editorial: Lament our current state of affairs, and then …
item.description: We must lament the current state of our country and our world. And we must not stop there. Lament calls us to do more.

item.title: Health means caring for the whole pastor
item.description: Bobby Contreras and colleagues launched The Whole Pastor to support pastors’ holistic health—spiritual, mental, physical, relational, and financial—so they can thrive personally and sustain long-term ministry.
